papers.title: Does laparoscopic-assisted transanal endorectal pull-through improve outcomes compared with transanal endorectal pull-through in Hirschsprung disease? A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Sisodiya R, Acharya H, Tomar A, Agrawal V, Tiwari A
papers.abstract: TERPT and LA-TERPT are widely used minimally invasive procedures for HD treatment. However, the comparative superiority of either technique in terms of postoperative complications and long-term functional outcomes remains uncertain. An SRMA was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines and prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261378340). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, and trial registries were searched from inception to May 3, 2026. Comparative studies evaluating TERPT and LA-TERPT in children with HD were included. The primary outcomes were constipation, soiling, fecal incontinence, BFS, HAEC, anastomotic stricture, and anastomotic leak. Secondary outcomes included operative time and hospital stay. A random-effects meta-analysis was performed using log risk ratios (RRs) or mean differences (MDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Twenty-three studies involving 1,668 children with HD were included, comprising 980 TERPT and 688 LA-TERPT procedures. No significant differences were observed between TERPT and LA-TERPT for constipation (log RR = 0.11), soiling (log RR = 0.05), fecal incontinence (log RR = 0.05), HAEC (log RR = 0.09), BFS > 17 (log RR = - 0.08), anastomotic stricture (log RR = 0.28), or anastomotic leak (log RR = 0.06). TERPT was associated with a significantly shorter operative time (MD = -43.25 min). Post-op hospital stay was comparable between groups (MD = 0.20 days). Most outcomes showed low heterogeneity, whereas operative time and hospital stay showed substantial heterogeneity. This SRMA found no clear evidence that either TERPT or LA-TERPT yields superior postoperative or functional outcomes in children with RSHD. However, the available evidence is largely observational and has low to moderate certainty, so it should be interpreted cautiously. Until higher-quality evidence becomes available, the choice of surgical approach should be guided by disease characteristics, technical considerations, and surgeon expertise.

papers.title_zh: 腹腔鏡輔助經肛門直腸內拖出術（LA-TERPT）是否優於單純經肛門直腸內拖出術（TERPT）治療先天性巨結腸症？系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: TERPT與LA-TERPT為廣泛使用於先天性巨結腸症（HD）治療之微創術式。然而兩種術式在術後併發症與長期功能結果上何者較優，目前仍不明確。本統合分析（SRMA）依循PRISMA 2020指引進行，並已於PROSPERO前瞻性註冊（CRD420261378340）。檢索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science、Google Scholar及試驗登錄資料庫，自建置起至2026年5月3日。納入比較TERPT與LA-TERPT於HD兒童病人之比較性研究。主要結果為便秘、汙糞、大便失禁、BFS（排便功能評分）、小腸結腸炎（HAEC）、吻合口狹窄、吻合口滲漏；次要結果為手術時間與住院天數。採用隨機效應模型，以對數風險比（log RR）或平均差（MD）及95%信賴區間進行統合分析。共納入23篇研究、1,668名HD兒童，包括980例TERPT與688例LA-TERPT。TERPT與LA-TERPT在便秘（log RR = 0.11）、汙糞（log RR = 0.05）、大便失禁（log RR = 0.05）、HAEC（log RR = 0.09）、BFS > 17（log RR = -0.08）、吻合口狹窄（log RR = 0.28）、吻合口滲漏（log RR = 0.06）方面均無顯著差異。TERPT組手術時間顯著較短（MD = -43.25分鐘）。術後住院天數兩組相當（MD = 0.20天）。多數結果異質性偏低，惟手術時間與住院天數異質性顯著偏高。本SRMA未發現明確證據顯示TERPT或LA-TERPT在術後或功能性結果上何者較優。然而現有證據多來自觀察性研究，證據確定性為低至中等，結果應謹慎解讀。在更高品質證據出現前，手術方式之選擇應依疾病特徵、技術考量與術者經驗決定。
papers.score_reason: 納入研究多為觀察性、證據確定性低至中等，結果多為陰性；且主題為兒童先天性巨結腸症，非成人大腸直腸外科日常業務範疇。

papers.title: Comparison of Short-Term Outcomes of Intracorporeal Anastomosis in Robot-Assisted colon Resection and Laparoscopic colon Resection: A Single-Center Study and Systematic Review and meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Tomita Y, Shigeta K, Momose Y, Monno M, Morita S, Okabayashi K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: This study evaluates short-term outcomes of robot-assisted (Rt) and laparoscopic (Lap) intracorporeal anastomosis (IA) in colon resection using an exploratory single-center retrospective cohort and a systematic review and meta-analysis conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines.
METHODS: Patients with colon cancer who underwent laparoscopic or robotic surgery at our institution from 2015 to 2024 were retrospectively enrolled. Additionally, a meta-analysis was conducted using PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library to identify studies comparing Rt-IA and Lap-IA. Short-term outcomes were statistically compared between the two groups.
RESULTS: A total of 77 patients were included (Rt-IA 26, Lap-IA 51). Intraoperative blood loss was significantly lower in the Rt-IA group (median, 5 mL vs. 10 mL; p = 0.001). No statistically significant differences were detected in major postoperative complications or most recovery-related outcomes. For the meta-analysis, 11 studies (1 prospective and 10 retrospective) met the inclusion criteria. After adding our institutional data, the pooled analysis showed that operative time was significantly longer in the Rt-IA group (MD, 54.02 min; 95% CI, 34.18-73.86; I2 = 95.4%), whereas the Rt-IA group demonstrated significantly less blood loss (MD, -14.33 mL; 95% CI: -27.04 to -1.63; I2 = 19.3%).
CONCLUSIONS: The results of our institutional analysis together with meta-analysis suggest that Rt-IA may be associated with longer operative time but slightly lower blood loss than Lap-IA. These findings suggest that Rt-IA may be a feasible alternative to Lap-IA; however, the results should be interpreted with caution given the limitations of the available evidence.

papers.title_zh: 機器人輔助與腹腔鏡大腸切除術體內吻合之短期預後比較：單中心研究合併系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：本研究以探索性單中心回溯性世代研究及依PRISMA準則進行之系統性回顧與統合分析，評估機器人輔助（Rt）與腹腔鏡（Lap）體內吻合（IA）在大腸切除術中之短期預後。方法：回溯性納入2015至2024年於本院接受腹腔鏡或機器人手術之大腸癌病人。另外，透過PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus及Cochrane Library進行統合分析，納入比較Rt-IA與Lap-IA之研究。統計比較兩組間之短期預後。結果：共納入77名病人（Rt-IA 26名，Lap-IA 51名）。Rt-IA組術中出血量顯著較少（中位數5 mL vs. 10 mL；p = 0.001）。主要術後併發症及大多數恢復相關指標無統計學顯著差異。統合分析部分共納入11篇研究（1篇前瞻性、10篇回溯性）。加入本機構資料後，統合分析顯示Rt-IA組手術時間顯著較長（平均差異54.02分鐘；95%信賴區間34.18-73.86；I2 = 95.4%），而Rt-IA組出血量顯著較少（平均差異-14.33 mL；95%信賴區間-27.04至-1.63；I2 = 19.3%）。結論：本機構分析結合統合分析結果顯示，Rt-IA可能較Lap-IA手術時間更長，但出血量略少。此結果顯示Rt-IA可能是Lap-IA之可行替代方案，然而鑑於現有證據之限制，結果應審慎解讀。
papers.score_reason: 統合分析異質性極高(I2=95.4%)、多為回溯性研究，單中心世代人數少且分組不對等，證據強度有限；但議題貼近日常機器人化大腸手術決策。

papers.title: Recombinant human Thymosin β4 ameliorates experimental colitis and intestinal fibrosis through suppression of mineralocorticoid receptor signaling
papers.authors: Zhao T, Hu E, Wang M, Zhai Y, Mao Y, Hou W
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic inflammatory disorder characterized by epithelial barrier disruption, persistent mucosal inflammation, and progressive intestinal fibrosis, for which effective therapeutic options remain limited. Thymosin β4 (Tβ4) is a highly conserved endogenous peptide with established roles in tissue repair and immune regulation, but its contribution to IBD pathogenesis has not been fully elucidated. Here, we found that TMSB4X, the gene encoding Tβ4, was downregulated in colonic tissues of IBD patients. To investigate its functional significance, we generated Tmsb4x-deficient mice and demonstrated that loss of endogenous Tβ4 markedly increased susceptibility to dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis. Conversely, oral administration of recombinant human Tβ4 (rhTβ4) significantly improved survival, alleviated body weight loss, reduced epithelial injury, and suppressed inflammatory cytokine production in both prophylactic and therapeutic colitis models. Furthermore, rhTβ4 attenuated intestinal fibrosis, as evidenced by reduced expression of fibrosis-associated markers and decreased collagen I deposition. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that rhTβ4 partially restored DSS-induced gene dysregulation and suppressed mineralocorticoid receptor (MR, NR3C2) signaling, a pathway further supported by reporter assays and downstream target gene analyses. Collectively, these findings identify Tβ4 as an endogenous protective factor against intestinal inflammation and fibrosis and suggest that pharmacological restoration of Tβ4 activity may represent a promising therapeutic strategy for IBD through modulation of mineralocorticoid receptor signaling.

papers.title_zh: 重組人類胸腺素β4（Thymosin β4）透過抑制礦物皮質素受體訊號傳導改善實驗性結腸炎與腸道纖維化
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種慢性發炎性疾病，特徵為上皮屏障破壞、持續黏膜發炎與進行性腸道纖維化，目前有效治療選項仍有限。胸腺素β4（Tβ4）是一種高度保守的內源性肽，已知在組織修復與免疫調控中扮演角色，但其在IBD病理機轉中的貢獻尚未完全闡明。本研究發現，編碼Tβ4的基因TMSB4X在IBD患者結腸組織中表達下降。為探討其功能意義，我們建立Tmsb4x基因缺失小鼠，證實內源性Tβ4缺失顯著增加對右旋葡聚糖硫酸鈉（DSS）誘導結腸炎的易感性。相反地，口服重組人類Tβ4（rhTβ4）在預防性與治療性結腸炎模型中均顯著改善存活率、減輕體重減輕、降低上皮損傷並抑制發炎性細胞激素產生。此外，rhTβ4減輕腸道纖維化，表現為纖維化相關標記表達降低與第一型膠原蛋白沉積減少。轉錄體分析顯示，rhTβ4部分回復DSS誘導的基因失調並抑制礦物皮質素受體（MR，NR3C2）訊號傳導，此路徑進一步經報告基因分析與下游目標基因分析證實。總結而言，這些發現確立Tβ4為對抗腸道發炎與纖維化的內源性保護因子，並提示藥理性恢復Tβ4活性可能透過調控礦物皮質素受體訊號傳導，成為IBD具潛力的治療策略。

papers.title: Roles of TIR domain-containing adaptor protein in tumor: Inflammation and immune regulation via toll-like receptor signaling
papers.journal_full: The Journal of international medical research
papers.authors: Jiang H, Zhang R, Ding S, Yu Z, Qi C, Meng J
papers.abstract: This narrative review aimed to critically synthesize and evaluate the current evidence on the roles of TIR domain-containing adaptor protein in tumorigenesis and cancer progression, with a particular focus on elucidating the underlying inflammatory and immune regulatory mechanisms mediated by toll-like receptor signaling. A targeted literature search of recent studies (2015-2024) was performed using PubMed and Web of Science. Classic foundational publications (1998-2014) were supplemented through reference tracking. We included experimental, cellular, and clinical studies focusing on TIR domain-containing adaptor protein in cancer. The synthesized findings indicate that TIR domain-containing adaptor protein has been implicated in malignant progression in bladder, pancreatic, and gastric cancers by sustaining chronic inflammation and shaping an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment through the TLR2/4-MyD88-NF-κB/MAPK axis, whereas it may exert homeostatic and protective effects in colorectal cancer. TIR domain-containing adaptor protein activity is tightly regulated by cellular origin, ligand specificity, and epigenetic modifications such as promoter methylation, which are closely associated with cancer risk and disease severity. TIR domain-containing adaptor protein serves as a critical regulator in inflammation-driven tumors with distinct context-dependent functions and represents a promising biomarker and therapeutic target. Further research focusing on its precise regulatory mechanisms and cell-specific targeted strategies will facilitate its clinical translation.

papers.abstract_zh: 本敘事性文獻回顧旨在批判性統整並評估目前關於TIR結構域含接頭蛋白(TIRAP)在腫瘤發生與癌症進展中角色的證據，特別聚焦於闡明由類鐸受體(TLR)訊息傳遞所介導的發炎與免疫調節機制。研究團隊使用PubMed與Web of Science進行針對性文獻搜尋（2015-2024年近期研究），並透過參考文獻追蹤補充經典基礎文獻（1998-2014年）。納入聚焦於TIRAP在癌症中角色的實驗性、細胞性及臨床研究。統整結果顯示，TIRAP在膀胱癌、胰臟癌與胃癌中，透過TLR2/4-MyD88-NF-κB/MAPK軸線維持慢性發炎並塑造免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境，因而牽涉於惡性進展；然而在大腸直腸癌(CRC)中，TIRAP可能發揮恆定與保護性作用。TIRAP的活性受到細胞來源、配體特異性以及啟動子甲基化等表觀遺傳修飾的嚴密調控，這些因素與癌症風險及疾病嚴重度密切相關。TIRAP在發炎驅動型腫瘤中扮演關鍵調控者角色，具有情境依賴性的獨特功能，並代表一個具潛力的生物標記與治療標的。未來聚焦於其精確調控機制與細胞特異性標靶策略的研究，將有助於其臨床轉譯。

papers.title: Public preferences for robotic surgery across two cancer scenarios: a latent class discrete choice study
papers.authors: Shin Y, Ro J, Kim Y, Nhem D, Tuvshinjargal E
papers.abstract: Public preferences for robotic surgery may reflect different responses to the technology, physician recommendation, cost, and clinical context. This study characterized latent preference profiles across colorectal and thyroid cancer scenarios using a joint model with shared class membership and scenario-specific utilities. A discrete choice experiment was conducted among 1,012 Korean adults. Colorectal cancer choices compared robotic and laparoscopic surgery, whereas thyroid cancer choices included robotic, endoscopic, and open surgery. Attributes included out-of-pocket cost, physician recommendation, and family or acquaintance influence; the thyroid scenario incorporated a scar-sparing profile. A joint latent class logit model shared class membership across scenarios while allowing scenario-specific utilities. Two- to four-class models were evaluated using multistart estimation, and a one-step model examined characteristics associated with class membership. The three-class model characterized context-sensitive (60.6%), technology-positive (29.1%), and conventional-surgery-oriented (10.3%) profiles (mean maximum posterior probability, 0.948). The technology-positive class favored robotic surgery in both scenarios but also responded to physician recommendation. The context-sensitive class had positive utility for the thyroid scar-sparing profile but negative incremental utility for robotic over endoscopic surgery. Higher technology acceptance (OR, 3.17; 95% CI, 2.49-4.03) and previous cancer experience (OR, 2.31; 95% CI, 1.20-4.45) were associated with technology-positive membership. Stated preferences among general adults for robotic surgery reflected distinct valuation profiles rather than a single pattern of acceptance. Apparent demand for robotic surgery may arise through different combinations of technology preference, physician recommendation, cost, and scenario-specific considerations. These demand-side preference patterns provide testable hypotheses about how public preferences may interact with provider adoption in the diffusion of high-cost surgical technologies.
papers.title_zh: 大眾對機器手臂手術在兩種癌症情境下之偏好：潛在類別離散選擇研究
papers.abstract_zh: 大眾對機器手臂手術之偏好，可能反映對此技術、醫師建議、費用與臨床情境的不同反應。本研究運用聯合模型（共享類別歸屬並允許情境特異效用），描繪大腸直腸癌與甲狀腺癌情境下的潛在偏好輪廓。共針對1,012名韓國成人進行離散選擇實驗。大腸直腸癌選項比較機器手臂手術與腹腔鏡手術，甲狀腺癌選項則包含機器手臂、內視鏡與傳統開放手術。屬性包括自付費用、醫師建議，以及家人或熟人的影響；甲狀腺癌情境另納入「保留疤痕外觀」之選項。聯合潛在類別logit模型於兩情境間共享類別歸屬，但允許情境特異之效用。以多起始點估計評估二至四類別模型，並以單步模型檢視與類別歸屬相關之特徵。三類別模型描繪出情境敏感型（60.6%）、科技正向型（29.1%）與傳統手術導向型（10.3%）三種輪廓（平均最大後驗機率0.948）。科技正向型在兩種情境中皆偏好機器手臂手術，但也會受醫師建議影響。情境敏感型對甲狀腺癌保留疤痕選項具正向效用，但對機器手臂相對於內視鏡手術之增量效用為負值。較高的科技接受度（OR 3.17，95% CI 2.49–4.03）與過去癌症經驗（OR 2.31，95% CI 1.20–4.45）與科技正向型類別歸屬相關。一般大眾對機器手臂手術的陳述性偏好，反映出多種不同的評價輪廓，而非單一的接受模式。對機器手臂手術的表面需求，可能源自技術偏好、醫師建議、費用與情境特異考量的不同組合。這些需求端的偏好模式，為高成本外科技術擴散過程中，大眾偏好如何與提供者採用行為互動，提供了可檢驗的假說。

papers.title: Economic transition during robotic colorectal surgery implementation: reduced device costs and improved gross profit per hospital day
papers.authors: Fujimoto Y, Honboh T, Nuruki K, Izumi T, Yoshida R, Harada N
papers.abstract: Robotic colorectal surgery is associated with substantial device-related costs, but longitudinal economic changes during implementation remain incompletely understood. We evaluated temporal changes in perioperative and economic outcomes during robotic colorectal surgery implementation. This single-center retrospective study included 119 consecutive robotic colorectal resections performed between June 2024 and October 2025. Cases were divided into early (n = 60) and late (n = 59) eras for descriptive comparison. Continuous temporal trends were evaluated with adjustment for tumor location, energy platform, and primary surgeon. Median total device cost decreased from 57.3 × 10⁴ to 51.2 × 10⁴ Japanese yen (JPY) (p < 0.001), and total hospital stay decreased from 9.0 to 8.0 days (p = 0.008). Gross profit per case did not differ significantly between eras (100.5 vs. 105.5 × 10⁴ JPY, p = 0.6), whereas gross profit per hospital day increased from 11.0 to 12.9 × 10⁴ JPY/day (p < 0.001). In adjusted continuous analyses, advancing case sequence was associated with higher gross profit per hospital day (ratio per 10 cases, 1.030; 95% confidence interval, 1.018-1.042), shorter total hospital stay (0.961; 0.932-0.991), and lower total device cost (0.982; 0.976-0.989). Advancing case sequence was associated with lower device costs, shorter hospitalization, and higher gross profit per hospital day, while gross profit per case did not significantly differ between eras. These findings are consistent with improved hospital-day economic efficiency rather than increased per-case profitability and should be interpreted as temporal associations.

papers.abstract_zh: 機器人大腸直腸手術伴隨可觀的設備相關成本，但導入過程中經濟指標的縱向變化尚未完全釐清。本研究評估機器人大腸直腸手術導入期間圍術期與經濟結果的時序變化。此為單一中心回溯性研究，納入2024年6月至2025年10月間連續119例機器人大腸直腸切除手術。病例分為早期（n=60）與晚期（n=59）以進行描述性比較。並針對腫瘤位置、能量平台及主刀醫師進行校正，評估連續性時序趨勢。中位總設備成本從57.3萬日圓降至51.2萬日圓（p<0.001），總住院天數從9.0天降至8.0天（p=0.008）。每例毛利在兩期間無顯著差異（100.5 vs. 105.5萬日圓，p=0.6），而每住院日毛利從11.0萬日圓/天增加至12.9萬日圓/天（p<0.001）。在校正後的連續性分析中，病例序數增加與較高的每住院日毛利相關（每增加10例的比值，1.030；95%信賴區間1.018-1.042）、較短的總住院天數相關（0.961；0.932-0.991）、以及較低的總設備成本相關（0.982；0.976-0.989）。病例序數增加與較低的設備成本、較短住院天數及較高的每住院日毛利相關，而每例毛利在兩期間並無顯著差異。這些發現符合每住院日經濟效率提升，而非每例獲利能力增加，且應解讀為時序上的關聯性。

papers.title: Textbook outcome of robotic rectal resection with primary anastomosis for cancer: a composite quality measure to evaluate functional and midterm outcomes
papers.authors: Guadagni S, Comandatore A, Furbetta N, Di Franco G, Gaeta R, Borelli B
papers.abstract: Textbook outcome (TO) is an "all-or-none" composite quality metric increasingly used to benchmark oncologic surgery, but its relationship with functional recovery after rectal cancer resection remains unclear. We evaluated TO after robotic rectal resection with primary anastomosis, identified predictors of TO achievement, and assessed associations with oncologic and urogenital outcomes. We retrospectively analyzed consecutive patients undergoing robotic rectal cancer resection with primary anastomosis between January 2015 and December 2025 in a high-volume robotic general surgery unit. Pelvic magnetic resonance imaging pelvimetry was reviewed preoperatively. Validated urinary and sexual function questionnaires were administered preoperatively and at 1, 6, and 12 months postoperatively. Disease-free survival (DFS) was assessed in stage II-III patients. Among 115 patients, 67 (58.2%) achieved TO. On multivariable logistic regression, greater interspinous distance was independently associated with higher likelihood of TO achievement (odds ratio 1.57 per 1-cm increase; 95% confidence interval 1.03-2.52; p = 0.046). In stage II-III patients, TO achievement was associated with improved DFS (86.9% vs. 61.5%; log-rank p = 0.028). Urinary function worsened at 1 month in both groups but returned to baseline by 12 months only in patients achieving TO. TO was achieved in nearly 60% of patients undergoing robotic rectal resection with primary anastomosis. TO was associated with favorable pelvic anatomy, improved disease control, and better urinary recovery. These findings support TO as a meaningful composite quality benchmark integrating perioperative, oncologic, and patient-reported outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 機器人直腸癌切除併原位吻合之教科書式結果（Textbook Outcome）：整合功能性與中期結果的複合品質指標
papers.abstract_zh: 教科書式結果（TO）是一種「全有或全無」的複合品質指標，日益被用於腫瘤手術的標竿評估，但其與直腸癌切除術後功能恢復之間的關係仍不明確。我們評估機器人直腸癌切除併原位吻合後的TO表現，找出達成TO的預測因子，並評估其與腫瘤學與泌尿生殖功能結果的關聯性。我們回溯性分析2015年1月至2025年12月間，於一高手術量機器人一般外科單位連續接受機器人直腸癌切除併原位吻合的病人。術前檢視骨盆磁振造影骨盆測量。於術前及術後1、6、12個月施行經驗證之泌尿與性功能問卷。第II-III期病人評估無病生存期（DFS）。在115名病人中，67名（58.2%）達成TO。多變項邏輯回歸分析顯示，較大的椎間徑（interspinous distance）與較高的TO達成機率獨立相關（每增加1公分之勝算比1.57；95%信賴區間1.03-2.52；p=0.046）。在第II-III期病人中，達成TO與較佳的DFS相關（86.9% vs. 61.5%，log-rank p=0.028）。兩組病人的泌尿功能於術後1個月皆惡化，但僅達成TO的病人在術後12個月恢復至基線水準。近60%接受機器人直腸癌切除併原位吻合的病人達成TO。TO與良好的骨盆解剖、較佳的疾病控制及較佳的泌尿功能恢復相關。這些發現支持TO作為整合圍術期、腫瘤學及病人報告結果的有意義複合品質標竿。
papers.score_reason: 單中心回溯性研究、樣本量小（n=115）且橫跨10年，TO與DFS的關聯恐有適應症混淆，屬假說產生階段，對臨床決策實用性有限。
papers.relevance_why: 機器人直腸癌手術在台灣醫學中心日益普及，主題直接相關，但本研究方法學薰弱、結論尚無法直接改變臨床做法。
papers.one_liner: 在115名接受機器人直腸癌切除併原位吻合的病人中，58.2%達成TO，第II-III期病人TO達成者DFS較佳（86.9% vs 61.5%）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變手術方式；可將TO納入機器人直腸癌手術品質追蹤指標，但不宜以此單一研究調整臨床決策。

pico.P: 115名2015-2025年間於單一高手術量中心接受機器人直腸癌切除併原位吻合的病人
pico.O: 主要：TO達成率及其預測因子（骨盆解剖、術式因素）；次要：無病生存期（DFS）、泌尿與性功能恢復

key_numbers: 椎間徑（interspinous distance）每增加1cm，TO達成OR 1.57（95% CI 1.03-2.52, p=0.046）
第II-III期病人DFS：TO達成86.9% vs 未達成61.5%（log-rank p=0.028）
cautions: TO與DFS的關聯屬回溯性觀察，可能存在適應症混淆（術中順利者本身疾病較輕或分期較佳），非因果關係
樣本量小（n=115），研究期間長達10年（2015-2025），手術技術與病人選擇可能隨時間變化影響結果
骨盆測量預測因子95% CI過寬（1.03-2.52），臨床意義有限；泌尿/性功能問卷可能有未報告的失訪率
papers.context: 先前兩篇論文建立了大腸手術（含機器人）TO的定義與失敗原因分析，本篇則將TO概念延伸應用至機器人直腸癌切除，並首次整合腫瘤學（DFS）與病人報告泌尿性功能結果，補上前作未涉及的功能性/中期結果缺口。

papers.title: Evaluation of the Validity and Reliability of the Persian Version of IBDcQ-8 Questionnaire
papers.authors: Moallem S, Malekzadeh M, Kasaeian A, Alatab S, Sima A, Ahadi M
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The 8-item Inflammatory Bowel Disease control Questionnaire-8 (IBDcQ-8) is a patient-reported measure designed to capture the core domains of disease control and quality of life. The aim of this study was to evaluate the validity and reliability of the Persian version of the IBDcQ-8 in the Iranian IBD population.
METHODS: A standardized forward-backward translation procedure was employed to adapt the questionnaire into Persian. Content validity was evaluated through structured interviews with a panel of 10 evaluators. Construct validity was examined by structured interview and clinical visits of 101 patients. Harvey Bradshaw Index (HBI), partial Mayo score, and IBD Questionnaire (IBDQ) were used as comparator instruments. Patients' responses were compared with clinical global assessment, Harvey Bradshaw Index (HBI), partial Mayo score, IBDQ score , and laboratory markers using Spearman's rank correlation. Test-retest reliability was evaluated by calculating the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) between the two subsequent interviews. A P-value<0.05 was considered statistically significant.
RESULTS: Half of the subjects (n=51 (50.5%)) were female. The mean age was 38 years (SD=14). Sixty-seven patients (66%) had UC. IBDcQ-8 scores showed strong correlations with HBI and IBDQ, and moderate correlations with the partial Mayo score, CRP, and clinical evaluation at the first visit (P-value<0.05). Agreement was excellent for one-day follow-up (ICC=0.82, 95% CI: 0.71-0.89, P<0.001), and moderate for two-week follow-up (ICC=0.61, 95% CI: 0.44-0.73, P<0.001).
CONCLUSION: The Persian version of the IBDcQ-8 questionnaire demonstrated robust validity and acceptable reliability even when administered by telephone interview, supporting its usefulness for evaluating disease-specific quality of life in patients with IBD and its applicability in future studies.
papers.title_zh: 波斯語版 IBDcQ-8 問卷之效度與信度評估
papers.abstract_zh: 前言：發炎性腸道疾病控制問卷-8（IBDcQ-8）是一項患者自評工具，用於評估疾病控制與生活品質的核心領域。本研究目的為評估波斯語版 IBDcQ-8 在伊朗 IBD 族群中的效度與信度。方法：採用標準化正向-反向翻譯程序將問卷改編為波斯語。內容效度透過 10 位評估者組成的小組進行結構化訪談評估。建構效度則透過對 101 名患者進行結構化訪談與臨床就診檢視。以 Harvey Bradshaw Index（HBI）、partial Mayo score 及 IBD Questionnaire（IBDQ）作為比較工具。患者的回答與臨床整體評估、HBI、partial Mayo score、IBDQ 分數及實驗室指標以 Spearman 等級相關進行比較。重測信度以兩次訪談間的組內相關係數（ICC）計算評估。P 值<0.05 視為統計顯著。結果：受試者中一半為女性（n=51，50.5%）。平均年齡 38 歲（SD=14）。67 名患者（66%）為潰瘍性結腸炎。IBDcQ-8 分數與 HBI、IBDQ 呈強相關，與 partial Mayo score、CRP 及首次就診臨床評估呈中度相關（P值<0.05）。一天後追蹤的一致性為優（ICC=0.82，95% CI：0.71–0.89，P<0.001），兩週追蹤的一致性為中等（ICC=0.61，95% CI：0.44–0.73，P<0.001）。結論：波斯語版 IBDcQ-8 問卷展現出穩健的效度與可接受的信度，即使以電話訪談方式進行亦然，支持其用於評估 IBD 患者疾病特異性生活品質的實用性，並可應用於未來研究。
papers.score_reason: 此為波斯語問卷翻譯效度驗證研究，非手術或治療性研究，對台灣大腸直腸外科臨床決策幾無直接實用性。
papers.relevance_why: 本文為 IBD 生活品質問卷在伊朗人群的語言驗證研究，非外科介入、非台灣族群，與大腸直腸外科手術決策無關。
papers.one_liner: 在101名伊朗IBD患者中，驗證波斯語版IBDcQ-8問卷之效度信度，發現與HBI、IBDQ強相關（ICC 0.82於一天追蹤）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法，此為特定語言問卷驗證研究，不影響台灣臨床手術或藥物治療決策。

pico.P: 101名伊朗IBD患者（潰瘍性結腸炎66%），另10位評估者進行內容效度評估
pico.I: 波斯語版IBDcQ-8問卷（透過標準前向-反向翻譯改編）
pico.C: 無對照組（與HBI、partial Mayo score、IBDQ等既有工具比較效標效度）
pico.O: 主要：與臨床指標之相關性（效度）；次要：重測信度（ICC）

key_numbers: 與HBI、IBDQ呈強相關，與partial Mayo score、CRP呈中度相關（p<0.05，未提供相關係數數值）
一天追蹤重測信度優：ICC=0.82（95% CI 0.71–0.89）
兩週追蹤重測信度中等：ICC=0.61（95% CI 0.44–0.73），顯示長期穩定性較弱
cautions: 摘要未提供具體相關係數數值（僅以「強」「中度」文字描述），無法評估效度強度
兩週重測信度僅中等（ICC 0.61），可能反映疾病本身波動或問卷穩定性不足，作者未討論此限制

papers.title: Integrative bulk and single-cell transcriptomics identify a recurrence-prognostic risk model with exploratory associations with treatment-response phenotypes in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Li S, Li J, Bu X, Han M, Shi G
papers.abstract: Chemoresistance remains a major obstacle to improving outcomes in colorectal cancer (CRC), particularly among patients receiving 5-fluorouracil (5-FU)-based therapy. Here, we developed a READ-derived response-associated gene signature for recurrence stratification and performed exploratory cross-cohort evaluation in additional colorectal cancer cohorts, while further exploring its association with treatment-response phenotypes. In the GSE190826 cohort, pathological complete response (pCR) versus non-pCR status was used as a clinically annotated treatment-response phenotype for downstream screening. Using differential expression analysis in TCGA-READ, we identified 4277 differentially expressed genes and constructed a weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) to define clinically relevant modules. Genes from READ-related modules were further screened by logistic regression in GSE190826 and univariate Cox regression in TCGA-READ, yielding six prognostic genes associated with pathological non-response. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO)-Cox regression subsequently refined these candidates to a four-gene signature, including ENHO, BLACAT1, LEMD1, and ASNS, which was used to establish a READ-derived response-associated gene (RDRG) risk score. High-risk patients showed poorer recurrence-free survival in the TCGA-READ training set and an exploratory TCGA-READ testing subset, and exploratory evaluations in additional colorectal cancer cohorts (TCGA-COAD and GSE17536) showed similar recurrence-stratification trends, with moderate time-dependent AUC values in TCGA-READ (3-year AUC = 0.766; 5-year AUC = 0.714). Multivariate Cox analyses showed that the risk score remained associated with RFS after adjustment for clinical covariates, and a nomogram incorporating disease stage provided additional exploratory prognostic stratification. The RDRG score also showed only modest and exploratory associations with treatment-response phenotypes across multiple datasets. Single-cell RNA-seq analysis revealed that malignant cells contributed the highest risk scores, with enrichment of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), KRAS signaling, coagulation, and hypoxia-related programs in high-risk tumor cells. Among the four genes, LEMD1 showed the strongest malignant-cell enrichment and was further examined in functional assays, where LEMD1 knockdown reduced CRC cell migration and increased 5-FU sensitivity, supporting its role as a candidate functional contributor rather than a validated mechanistic driver. Collectively, the RDRG risk score may serve as a READ-derived model for recurrence stratification, with exploratory cross-cohort applicability in broader colorectal cancer cohorts and exploratory associations with treatment-response phenotypes. The same risk-score formula was applied across cohorts, whereas high- and low-risk thresholds were cohort-specific rather than fixed from the training cohort.

papers.title_zh: 整合大量與單細胞轉錄體學鑑定一個復發預後風險模型，並探索性地與大腸直腸癌治療反應表型的關聯
papers.abstract_zh: 化療抗藥性仍是改善大腸直腸癌（CRC）預後的主要障礙，尤其是在接受5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）為基礎治療的病人中。本研究開發了一個源自直腸癌（READ）的反應相關基因特徵，用於復發分層，並在其他大腸直腸癌世代中進行探索性跨世代評估，同時進一步探討其與治療反應表型的關聯。在GSE190826世代中，病理完全反應（pCR）與非pCR狀態被用作臨床註記的治療反應表型，供下游篩選使用。透過TCGA-READ中的差異表現分析，我們鑑定出4277個差異表現基因，並建構加權基因共表現網路分析（WGCNA）以定義臨床相關模組。來自READ相關模組的基因進一步在GSE190826中以邏輯迴歸篩選，並於TCGA-READ中以單變量Cox迴歸篩選，得出六個與病理無反應相關的預後基因。最小絕對收縮與選擇算子（LASSO）-Cox迴歸隨後將候選基因精煉為四基因特徵，包括ENHO、BLACAT1、LEMD1及ASNS，用以建立READ衍生反應相關基因（RDRG）風險評分。高風險病人在TCGA-READ訓練集及探索性TCGA-READ測試子集中，均顯示較差的無復發存活（RFS），且在其他大腸直腸癌世代（TCGA-COAD及GSE17536）中的探索性評估亦顯示類似的復發分層趨勢，TCGA-READ中的時間相依AUC值中等（3年AUC=0.766；5年AUC=0.714）。多變量Cox分析顯示，在調整臨床共變項後，風險評分仍與RFS相關，納入疾病分期的列線圖提供了額外的探索性預後分層。RDRG評分在多個資料集中與治療反應表型僅顯示輕微且探索性的關聯。單細胞RNA定序分析顯示惡性細胞貢獻最高的風險評分，高風險腫瘤細胞中富集上皮間質轉化（EMT）、KRAS訊號傳導、凝血及缺氧相關程式。在四個基因中，LEMD1顯示最強的惡性細胞富集，並進一步以功能性試驗檢驗，LEMD1敲低降低了CRC細胞遷移能力並增加5-FU敏感性，支持其作為候選功能性貢獻者、而非經驗證的機制驅動者之角色。總體而言，RDRG風險評分可能作為一個源自READ的復發分層模型，在更廣泛的大腸直腸癌世代中具有探索性跨世代適用性，並與治療反應表型有探索性關聯。相同的風險評分公式應用於各世代，但高低風險閾值為各世代特定，而非固定自訓練世代。
papers.score_reason: 純資料庫探勘之基因特徵建構研究，摘要中反覆自稱「exploratory」，AUC僅中等（0.71-0.77），對臨床決策無直接可行性。
papers.relevance_why: 屬於基礎轉譯研究（生物資訊學基因特徵+細胞株功能實驗），非外科介入或臨床決策工具。
papers.one_liner: 利用TCGA-READ等世代建構4基因（ENHO/BLACAT1/LEMD1/ASNS）風險評分，高風險組RFS較差，3年AUC 0.766、5年AUC 0.714。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；此為探索性基因特徵模型，尚無前瞻性臨床驗證，無法用於病人分層或治療決策。

pico.C: 無對照組（比較高風險 vs 低風險分層）
pico.O: 主要：無復發存活（RFS）；次要：與病理完全反應（pCR）等治療反應表型的關聯，及LEMD1敲低對細胞遷移與5-FU敏感性的功能性效果

key_numbers: TCGA-READ中3年AUC=0.766、5年AUC=0.714，屬中等預測力
4277個差異表現基因經WGCNA、邏輯迴歸、Cox迴歸、LASSO篩選後精煉為4基因
RDRG評分與治療反應表型（pCR）僅顯示「輕微且探索性」關聯，未達穩健水準
cautions: 全部基於TCGA/GEO回溯性公開資料庫探勘，無前瞻性世代驗證，AUC僅中等
摘要多次強調「exploratory」，作者自承結果為探索性而非驗證性結論，過度延伸恐有風險
功能性驗證僅LEMD1單一基因於細胞株層級（敲低實驗），未有動物模型或病人組織驗證

跨世代異質性（分期、治療方案差異）
試驗註冊（不適用於此類研究）
papers.context: 與先前看過的三篇TCGA/GEO基因特徵預後模型論文（NET/氧化壓力分型、OPISV模型、CCBE1巨噬細胞研究）屬同一類型：皆為公開資料庫探勘建構之分子預後模型，AUC或效度有限、缺乏前瞻性臨床驗證。本篇再次確認此類研究對臨床實務的可行性普遍偏低的模式。

papers.title: Macrophage-Driven Antitumor and Antimetastatic Activity of an Arabinogalactan from Anadenanthera colubrina
papers.authors: Araújo D, Silva V, Santos L, Nogueira M, de Oliveira F, Soares M
papers.abstract: Arabinogalactans are macromolecules with potential antitumor and antimetastatic effects, acting through modulation of the immune system, which makes them promising candidates for cancer immunotherapy. This study evaluated the immunomodulatory, antitumor, antimetastatic, and toxicological effects of an arabinogalactan isolated from Anadenanthera colubrina (RAG). RAG was structurally characterized by NMR, FTIR, zeta potential, and elemental analyses. Tumor and metastatic models were established in immunosuppressed mice transplanted with human colorectal cancer HCT-116 cells via subcutaneous and intravenous injections. After treatment, tumor growth, lung metastases, relative organ weight, histopathology, and immunofluorescence were evaluated. Structural characterization confirmed the presence of an arabinogalactan, with a protein content of 1.35% and a zeta potential of -29.47 mV. RAG significantly inhibited tumor growth by 63.5 ± 6.5% and 62.9 ± 8.3% at doses of 50 and 100 mg/kg/day, respectively, with areas of tumor necrosis observed. At the 100 mg/kg/day dose, no lung metastases were detected, whereas control and 50 mg/kg/day groups presented micrometastases and central necrosis. RAG also enhanced the antitumor immune response by increasing macrophage infiltration and promoting a pro-inflammatory macrophage-associated response, as indicated by increased expression of F4/80, TNF-α, and IL-12β, with no significant changes in IL-10. The expression of CD86 and CD206 showed no statistical difference, however, a trend toward increased CD86 and decreased CD206 was observed in treated groups. Regarding safety, no relevant histopathological alterations were observed at the 50 mg/kg/day dose, whereas the 100 mg/kg/day dose induced moderate vascular congestion and hepatic hemorrhagic infiltration. These findings suggest that RAG is a promising candidate for cancer immunotherapy, exerting antitumor and antimetastatic effects through activation of innate immunity.
papers.title_zh: 來自 Anadenanthera colubrina 之阿拉伯半乳聚糖透過巨噬細胞驅動的抗腫瘤與抗轉移活性
papers.abstract_zh: 阿拉伯半乳聚糖是具有潛在抗腫瘤與抗轉移效果的巨分子，透過調節免疫系統發揮作用，使其成為癌症免疫治療的有潛力候選物。本研究評估從 Anadenanthera colubrina 分離出的阿拉伯半乳聚糖（RAG）的免疫調節、抗腫瘤、抗轉移及毒理學效果。RAG 經由核磁共振（NMR）、傅立葉轉換紅外光譜（FTIR）、zeta電位及元素分析進行結構鑑定。在免疫抑制小鼠中以皮下及靜脈注射方式植入人類大腸直腸癌 HCT-116 細胞，建立腫瘤與轉移模型。治療後評估腫瘤生長、肺轉移、器官相對重量、組織病理學及免疫螢光。結構鑑定證實其為阿拉伯半乳聚糖，蛋白質含量為 1.35%，zeta電位為 -29.47 mV。RAG 在 50 及 100 mg/kg/day 劑量下分別顯著抑制腫瘤生長 63.5±6.5% 及 62.9±8.3%，並觀察到腫瘤壞死區域。在 100 mg/kg/day 劑量下未偵測到肺轉移，而對照組及 50 mg/kg/day 組則出現微轉移及中心壞死。RAG 亦增強抗腫瘤免疫反應，表現為巨噬細胞浸潤增加及促發炎性巨噬細胞相關反應增強，F4/80、TNF-α 及 IL-12β 表現增加，IL-10 則無顯著變化。CD86 及 CD206 表現無統計學差異，但治療組呈現 CD86 上升、CD206 下降之趨勢。安全性方面，50 mg/kg/day 劑量未觀察到明顯組織病理學變化，而 100 mg/kg/day 劑量則誘發中度血管充血及肝臟出血性浸潤。這些發現顯示 RAG 是癌症免疫治療的有潛力候選物，透過活化先天免疫發揮抗腫瘤與抗轉移效果。
